notes: REVIS CHAIR evaluation reproduced with Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct on 100 val2014 images. CHAIRS=20.00% (paper: 25.00%, rubric CI: [24.60, 29.00]), CHAIRI=6.53% (paper: 8.23%, rubric CI: [7.49, 8.30]). Both metrics are lower (better) than paper-reported values. However, baseline (no steering) shows nearly identical results (CHAIRS=20.00%, CHAIRI=6.61%), suggesting the pre-computed steering vector has negligible effect on the current Hugging Face model version. The Qwen2.5-VL model on HF may have been updated with improved visual grounding, reducing the baseline hallucination rate from 31% to 20%. Steering vectors may need recomputation for this model version to show the paper-claimed 19.35% hallucination reduction.
eval_output_format: JSON stdout with keys CHAIRs and CHAIRi as percentage floats. CHAIRs is sentence-level hallucination rate, CHAIRi is object-level.
known_levers: 1) Recompute steering vector with current model version (python3 main_all_visual_only.py compute). 2) Adjust alpha (steering intensity, paper optimum at 1.6). 3) Try different layers (paper optimum at layer 27 for Qwen2.5-VL-7B). 4) Adjust threshold percentile k (paper uses 0.8). 5) Try different max_new_tokens (64/128/512). 6) The tau_low and risk_gamma parameters control intervention sensitivity.
setup_notes: Container based on docker.1ms.run/pytorch/pytorch:2.1.0-cuda12.1-cudnn8-runtime. Key dependencies: transformers==4.53.0 (downgraded from 5.13.0 for PyTorch 2.1.0 compatibility), qwen-vl-utils, nltk, pycocotools, pycocoevalcap, inflect, accelerate, openjdk-11-jre-headless (for PTBTokenizer). Model Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct (16GB) downloaded from modelscope to /models. COCO val2014 annotations (808MB) downloaded via chunked HTTP Range requests from cocodataset.org to /datasets/coco/annotations. 100 val2014 images (~15MB) downloaded individually to /datasets/coco/val2014. Steering vector from repo vector/qwen2.5vl_none_image.pt (pre-computed). Stub modules created for missing text_halu.py and mmhal_bench.py. NLTK punkt data downloaded via jsDelivr CDN to /repo/utils/nltk_data.

optimization_objective.summary: Improve CHAIRS as the primary metric while maintaining or improving CHAIRI and general reasoning capability. The current baseline (no steering) is CHAIRS=20.00%. The REVIS steering should ideally reduce this further while preserving image description quality.

metrics.name: CHAIRS
metrics.rationale: Sentence-level object hallucination rate — the paper's primary metric. Paper reports 25.00% with REVIS; our reproduction baseline is 20.00%. REVIS steering should reduce this below baseline.

metrics.name: CHAIRI
metrics.rationale: Object-level hallucination rate — coupled with CHAIRS. Should not regress significantly when optimizing CHAIRS.

optimization_objective.success_policy: Primary goal: reduce CHAIRS below the baseline of 20.00% through effective REVIS steering. CHAIRI should not increase beyond ~7.2% (10% regression). Recomputing the steering vector for the current model version is the most promising optimization direction, as the pre-computed vector appears ineffective with the current Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct Hugging Face checkpoint.
